task.name: pick_red_marker_place_tray
task.description: Use the right arm to pick up the red marker and place it on the white tray.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the red marker.
2. Grasp the red marker with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align with the white tray.
4. Release the gripper to place the red marker on the white tray.
